cards.example_en: This peach tastes sweet because it ripened fully on the tree.
cards.example_zh: 这只桃子很甜，因为它在树上完全成熟了。

cards.example_en: Every pedestrian should use the crossing when the light turns green.
cards.example_zh: 绿灯亮起时，每位行人都应走斑马线。

cards.example_en: Grandma uses her pension to pay for food and bus fares.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶用年金支付饭钱和公交费。

cards.example_en: A light perfume drifted through the room after she walked past.
cards.example_zh: 她走过之后，一股淡淡的香水味在房间里飘散。

cards.example_en: Hospital personnel trained together for the emergency drill.
cards.example_zh: 医院的工作人员一起参加了应急演练。

cards.example_en: Farmers watch for any pest that might damage the young crops.
cards.example_zh: 农民留意任何可能损害幼苗的害虫。

cards.example_en: He bought a softer pillow because his neck hurt each morning.
cards.example_zh: 他买了一个更软的枕头，因为每天早上脖子都疼。

cards.example_en: She fastened the ribbon with a pin so it would not slip.
cards.example_zh: 她用一枚别针固定丝带，免得它滑落。

cards.example_en: Baking this cake takes a pint of milk and two eggs.
cards.example_zh: 烤这个蛋糕需要一品脱牛奶和两个鸡蛋。

cards.example_en: Some mushrooms look harmless but are poisonous if eaten.
cards.example_zh: 有些蘑菇看起来无害，吃下去却有毒。

cards.example_en: You must possess a student card to enter the lab.
cards.example_zh: 你必须拥有学生证才能进入实验室。

cards.example_en: Snow on Friday night is a real possibility.
cards.example_zh: 周五夜里确实有下雪的可能性。

cards.example_en: The recipe needs a precise amount of sugar.
cards.example_zh: 这个食谱需要精确的用糖量。

cards.example_en: My aunt is pregnant and avoids lifting heavy boxes.
cards.example_zh: 我阿姨怀孕了，避免搬重箱子。

cards.example_en: Good preparation made the oral exam feel easier.
cards.example_zh: 准备充分以后，口试就觉得容易些了。

cards.example_en: To ease the cough, the doctor wrote a prescription for medicine.
cards.example_zh: 为了缓解咳嗽，医生开了一张药方。

cards.example_en: Students watched a preview of the documentary before the discussion.
cards.example_zh: 讨论之前，学生们观看了这部纪录片的预告片。

cards.example_en: Speaking at the ceremony was a privilege she would not forget.
cards.example_zh: 在典礼上发言是她不会忘记的一份荣幸。

cards.example_en: Sunscreen gives protection on a bright sports afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 晴朗的运动日下午，防晒霜能提供保护。

cards.example_en: Following the long run, a nurse checked his pulse carefully.
cards.example_zh: 长跑结束后，一位护士仔细检查了他的脉搏。

cards.example_en: Being punctual shows respect for classmates who arrive on time.
cards.example_zh: 守时是对按时到达的同学的一种尊重。

cards.example_en: Correct punctuation makes a long sentence easier to understand.
cards.example_zh: 正确的标点使长句更容易理解。

cards.example_en: After the quake, volunteers brought water and blankets to families.
cards.example_zh: 地震之后，志愿者给各家各户送来了水和毯子。

cards.example_en: Workers handling radioactive material must wear special protective clothing.
cards.example_zh: 处理放射性物质的工人必须穿着特殊的防护服。

cards.example_en: He cleaned the muddy boots with a rag from the kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 他用厨房里的一块抹布擦净了沾满泥的靴子。

cards.example_en: Heavy rainfall filled the rivers and delayed the morning buses.
cards.example_zh: 大雨使河水上涨，并耽搁了早晨的公交车。

cards.example_en: He bought a new razor because the old one had grown dull.
cards.example_zh: 他买了一把新剃须刀，因为旧的已经变钝了。

cards.example_en: Guests enjoyed the wedding reception in a garden behind the hall.
cards.example_zh: 客人们在大厅后面的花园里参加了婚礼招待会。

cards.example_en: The architect drew a rectangle around the garden on the plan.
cards.example_zh: 建筑师在平面图上绕着花园画了一个长方形。

cards.example_en: After a long argument, the referee stopped the match and awarded a free kick.
cards.example_zh: 一番长时间的争执之后，裁判员中止了比赛并判罚任意球。

cards.example_en: In his religion, families share a quiet meal on holy days.
cards.example_zh: 按照他的宗教，家人在圣日会安静地一起吃饭。

cards.example_en: Many religious festivals include special family meals.
cards.example_zh: 许多宗教节日都包含特别的家庭聚餐。

cards.example_en: The twins resemble each other so closely that strangers often mix them up.
cards.example_zh: 这对双胞胎长得太像了，陌生人常常把他们认错。

cards.example_en: Please confirm your reservation at the hotel before six this evening.
cards.example_zh: 请在今晚六点前确认你的酒店预订。

cards.example_en: The villagers will resist the plan to close their clinic.
cards.example_zh: 村民们将抵制关闭他们诊所的计划。

cards.example_en: A restriction on visitors keeps the science lab quiet.
cards.example_zh: 对访客的限制让科学实验室保持安静。

cards.example_en: Our history book describes the revolution in France.
cards.example_zh: 我们的历史书描述了法国的那场革命。

cards.example_en: We must rid the kitchen of mice before the guests arrive.
cards.example_zh: 我们必须在客人到来之前清除厨房里的老鼠。

cards.example_en: Wearing sandals in deep snow looks completely ridiculous.
cards.example_zh: 在深雪里穿凉鞋看起来十分荒唐。

cards.example_en: These tomatoes will ripen faster if you leave them on the sunny windowsill.
cards.example_zh: 如果把这些番茄放在向阳的窗台上，它们会熟得更快。

cards.example_en: A rooster crowed loudly behind the barn just at sunrise.
cards.example_zh: 日出时分，一只公鸡在谷仓后面大声啼叫。

cards.example_en: Fruit left in a damp cellar will soon rot.
cards.example_zh: 放在潮湿地窖里的水果很快就会腐烂。

cards.example_en: Drivers must slow down before they enter the roundabout near the station.
cards.example_zh: 司机驶入车站附近的环岛之前必须减速。

cards.example_en: That mountain is sacred to the people who have lived nearby for centuries.
cards.example_zh: 那座山对世世代代住在附近的人们来说是神圣的。

cards.example_en: Parents often sacrifice their own comfort for their children's future.
cards.example_zh: 父母常常为了孩子的未来牺牲自己的舒适。

cards.example_en: Soldiers salute the national flag every morning in the square.
cards.example_zh: 士兵们每天早晨在广场上向国旗敬礼。

cards.example_en: I scan the menu before I order lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我点午餐之前先扫读一遍菜单。

cards.example_en: A thin scar still shows clearly on his left cheek.
cards.example_zh: 他的左脸颊上仍清晰地留着一道细疤。

cards.example_en: Scientists remained sceptical until the experiment was repeated successfully.
cards.example_zh: 在实验被成功重复之前，科学家们一直持怀疑态度。

cards.example_en: The young scholar published a paper on ancient Chinese poetry.
cards.example_zh: 这位年轻学者发表了一篇关于中国古代诗歌的论文。

word.example_en: Please get rid of these old boxes.
